items.quote:
came to Jehoiada the priest.
10  Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields
items.contrast: Jehoiada is the giver, whereas the commanders receive the weapons.
items.reason: “He” refers back to Jehoiada, and the commanders are explicitly the recipients. The phrase “temple weapons” is an avoidable and slightly misleading stand-in: the passage calls them King David’s spears and shields that were in the temple. Resolving the pronoun and distinguishing giver from recipients tests a meaningful relationship.
